annotation.primary_definition: >=max(3,ceil(0.01*n_Microglia_cells_animal)) positive cells per animal; >=2 qualifying animals
annotation.formal_enrichment: NOT_TESTED; coordinate fractions and relative folds are descriptive with no P values
annotation.base_pair_semantics: Sum over peak features, not a unique genomic base-pair union if feature intervals overlap
annotation.blacklist_policy: Any blacklist overlap excludes the entire peak feature from all accessible-region summaries; clipped geometry retained only in annotation audit
annotation.count_semantics: Deposited counts within accessible regions; not molecule-conserving TE fragment counts or RNA expression

matching.control_pool: complete-covariate nonquery published accessible peaks; pairs disjoint; no TE annotation used in matching

matching.multiple_testing: BH over any-primary-TE plus all class/family/subfamily features, including zero-observed features
matching.test: Two-sided exact paired label swap, binomial discordant-pair/McNemar form
limitations: Exploratory annotation association conditional on matched subset, not all Microglia peaks
Assumes within-pair genomic feature exchangeability; local genomic correlation may inflate significance
Not an animal condition test, TE fragment count, RNA expression or autonomous TE activity

scope: Published ATAC accessible-region TE annotation; not TE fragment counts or RNA expression
